in_marathi.name: Jaychand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaychand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jaychand is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jaya' which means 'victory' and 'Chand' which means 'moon'. The name symbolizes the power of the moon and the victories achieved through its influence.
